_comment: Near-miss merchant groups that string similarity gets wrong. Each group asserts a NEGATIVE fact -- these names are different merchants and must never collapse into one canonical form -- together with the evidence that settled it. The merchant master already keeps them apart by having separate entries, but that is an accident of its contents rather than a stated rule: nothing today fails if a future edit folds WTRSTNS into WAITROSE as an alias. This file is what fails. 'settled_by' records which evidence decided the split, matching the rule that a merge is confirmed against MCC and country, never against spelling. Evidence fields are optional: a group settled by a naming rule rather than by category carries no MCC, and the validator only checks what is stated.

never_merge.confusable_because: both are vowel-dropped forms of a long W-initial British retailer; edit distance between WTRS and WTRSTNS is 3
never_merge.note: Same country, so geography cannot separate them. MCC can: 5411 grocery against 5942 books.

never_merge.confusable_because: one trailing character apart, same country, both plausible transliterations of the same Arabic root
never_merge.note: The hardest pair in the file. Every signal except MCC agrees, and a trailing-E normaliser would merge them.

never_merge.confusable_because: CRM is a plausible consonant skeleton for both names
never_merge.note: CRM resolves to Careem. Both signals agree here, which is why this one was settleable and TSC S was not.

never_merge.confusable_because: three unrelated merchants sharing a first token; stripping the qualifier as a country suffix would collapse all three
never_merge.note: The documented exception to the country-qualifier rule. TOTAL LEBANON keeps its suffix precisely because bare TOTAL is ambiguous here, so this group is settled by the naming rule rather than by MCC.

unsettled.reason: Both 5411, but TSC S appears in LB and SULTAN CENTER in KW. The evidence disagrees, so nothing is asserted and TSC S stays in the review queue.
unsettled.note: Listed here so the absence of an assertion is itself recorded. Not enforced: TSC S has no entry in the merchant master to enforce against.
